settingsDaemonAsNmHostDesc.message: Talk to the daemon directly over native messaging (skip the `webhid-native-messaging` forwarder and Unix socket). Requires the `webhid.daemon_nm_host` native-messaging manifest to be installed and the daemon to run as your user (with the udev rule). Lower latency, but no root-daemon fallback. The addon reconnects automatically when toggled.

settingsDataPlaneDesc.message:
**WebSocket**: spawn Web Worker giữ kết nối WS tới daemon. Input report được chuyển tới page qua `postMessage` với ArrayBuffer transfer (ngoài main thread, zero-copy). Không SAB, không COOP/COEP.
**WebTransport**: cùng kiến trúc worker, hoặc ngay trong page khi tắt Use Worker (xem toggle đó), qua QUIC với chứng chỉ tự ký pinned bằng `serverCertificateHashes` (tốn CPU TLS/QUIC trên loopback).
**Native Messaging**: chuyển toàn bộ dữ liệu (sendReport, input reports, feature reports) qua NM host bằng content-script bridge. Không WS. Fallback khi WS bị chặn.

settingsDevicePickerModeDesc.message:
**Modal**: show a shadow DOM overlay on the page when `requestDevice()` is called (default, matches native WebHID behavior).
**Page Action**: switch the url bar icon to alert mode and open the device picker as a popup. User must click the icon to open the picker. Firefox only, Chromium will fall back to modal.

settingsWorkerPolyfillDesc.message: Inject WebHID API stubs into Web Worker scripts (`new Worker()`, `new SharedWorker()`). Workers get `navigator.hid`, `HIDDevice`, and related constructors. Methods throw `NotSupportedError` until full worker communication is implemented. Can be overridden per-site from the popup. Reload pages after changing.

settingsLogLevelDesc.message: Controls console output verbosity. Error = errors only, Warn = +warnings, Info = +info, Debug = +debug (includes performance timing). Reload pages after changing.

settingsWorkerSpawnModeDesc.message:
**Shadow URL** (default on MV3): spawns the data worker via `new Worker(location.href)` with a StreamFilter intercepting the synthetic self-request. Touches nothing about the page except one synthetic request. Fails if the server rejects that request or if `require-trusted-types-for` is active with a restrictive allow-list.
**Blob + CSP rewrite** (default on MV2): spawns the worker from a `blob:` URL created from the extension's worker bundle. No network dependency, but relaxes the page's `worker-src` and `connect-src` CSP directives to allow `blob:` and `ws://127.0.0.1:*`.

settingsUseWorkerDesc.message:
Bật: data plane WS/WT chạy trong Web Worker riêng (ngoài main thread, khuyến nghị).
Tắt: WebTransport kết nối trực tiếp trong page, không dùng worker, report được dispatch trên main thread (dùng chung CPU với rendering; ổn ở tốc độ report thường, chưa benchmark). WebSocket vẫn cần worker vì HSTS đổi `ws://` thành `wss://` trên page, nên tùy chọn WS vẫn dùng worker. Native Messaging không bị ảnh hưởng. Reload pages sau khi đổi.

popupUseWorkerDesc.message: Tắt: WebTransport kết nối trực tiếp trong page (dùng CPU main thread; ổn ở tốc độ report thường). WebSocket vẫn cần worker.
